23849.name: Klf6
23849.otheraliases: BCD1, CPBP, Copeb, FM2, FM6, Ierepo1, Ierepo3, Zf9
23849.otherdesignations: Krueppel-like factor 6|Kruppel-like factor 6|core promoter element binding protein|immediate early response, erythropoietin 1
23849.summary: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in positive regulation of connective tissue replacement. Acts upstream of or within cytokine-mediated signaling pathway. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including blastocyst-stage conceptus; central nervous system; embryo mesenchyme; eye; and genitourinary system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in prostate cancer and stomach cancer. Orthologous to human KLF6 (KLF transcription factor 6). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]
